heroRefinements.name: ribbon-knot-satin-v2
heroRefinements.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit. Input image: the exact edit target, an original multicolored ribbon knot used on a premium framework website. Preserve its precise silhouette, geometry, all openings and overlaps, orientation, relative proportions, and full uncropped framing. Preserve the distribution of its cobalt blue, warm persimmon orange, pale champagne and muted lilac colors. Change only the quality of the material and surface rendering: replace the low-poly computer-rendered finish with exquisite smooth satin resin, finely brushed pearlescent microtexture, subtle natural streaks following the ribbon direction, controlled soft specular highlights, and realistic contact occlusion where the ribbons pass each other. Fine tactile detail, no coarse scratches or heavy noise. Sophisticated sculptural design photography lighting; still the same original shape, no redesign. Absolutely no added objects, extra loops, typography, logos, shadows on a floor, or framing elements. A clean fully transparent background with genuine alpha; do not add a white or colored backdrop. The whole shape stays visible with its current generous transparent margins. High resolution.
